headline: Chapo seeks growth in China visit - CAJ News Africa
summary: Mozambican President Daniel Chapo is leading a high-level delegation to Beijing to accelerate economic transformation and infrastructure development. The visit aims to deepen strategic ties with China.
why: China is one of Africa's largest trade and investment partners, and infrastructure financing deals shape growth prospects for African economies and their borrowers.
